name: Marwareedi
indication_description:
Marwareedi is indicated in-
  • General debility
  • Nervous debility
  • Leucorrhoea
  • Menstrual irregularity
  • Dysmenorrhoea
  • Metritis
pharmacology_description: Marwareedi is a well known unani medicine. It acts as general tonic & nervine tonic. Marwareedi is also effective in leucorrhoea, menstrual irregularity, dysmenorrhoea and metritis.
dosage_description: 1-2 tablet(s) twice daily with milk or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
